show.description:
A billionaire heir hides his identity to escape his mother’s marriage plans, only to meet a heartbroken bride who proposes to him instead.
What starts as a marriage of convenience turns into a heartfelt journey through lies, love, and second chances. A story that proves—sometimes, love finds you where you least expect it.
